items.title: An ample family of invertible modules pulls back along affine and quasi-affine maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y a morphism of schemes which is affine or quasi-affine, if Y has an ample family of invertible modules then so does X. The retained proof is written as a quoted specialization: by Morphisms, lemma quasi-affine-O-ample (registered by lane S9 as S9-morph-ample-family-ample-relative's companion input) a quasi-affine target-relative ample family exists, and the claim is the special case of the chapter lemma ample-family-ample-relative (S9 registered) whose relative ample family hypothesis is met by that input; the author's line 'this is a special case' is the entire further argument. Retained author proof at lines 23343-23347.
